prompt: Create a premium fashion fast-food advertising poster for KFC. Use a vertical 4:5 editorial composition with a low-angle dynamic perspective: an elegant young East Asian woman in a refined red-and-white outfit leans forward toward the viewer, reaching into an oversized red-and-white striped fried chicken bucket in the foreground. She is holding one large golden crispy chicken piece between her fingers, with visible crumbs and tiny crunchy flakes suspended in the air. The bucket contains exactly 7 visible fried chicken pieces: 1 piece held in her hand, 4 distinct pieces clustered in the middle, 1 large blurred piece at the lower front edge, and 1 large piece on the right rim. Show the bucket with a clean black Colonel-style face logo and bold KFC lettering on the front. The model has soft glamorous makeup, red lips, warm skin glow, loose dark hair in an elegant messy updo, small gold hoop earrings, and a confident tempting expression looking slightly down toward the camera. Wardrobe: a deep red sleeveless tailored top or dress, white cropped jacket with rolled sleeves, white high-waisted wrap skirt or apron-like panel, and red side panels, creating a luxurious red-and-white brand palette. Background: minimalist cream studio wall with strong geometric red architectural panels and diagonal shadows, warm sunlight, high-end commercial photography lighting, shallow depth of field, crisp texture on the fried chicken, glossy fashion-magazine polish. Add headline text in the upper left: CRAVE THE CRUNCH in spaced uppercase serif letters, dark red. Add smaller subheading below: Freshly crispy. Made to tempt.. Keep the typography elegant and minimal, with ample negative space. Style should feel like a luxury fashion campaign fused with a fast-food commercial, photorealistic, high detail, appetizing food texture, dynamic hand-reaching motion, no extra logos or watermarks beyond the bucket branding and poster text.

promptZh: 为 KFC 创作一张精品时尚快餐广告海报。采用 4:5 竖版编辑构图，使用低角度动态视角：一位优雅的东亚年轻女性身着精致的红白配色服装，身体前倾朝向观众，伸手探入前景中一个超大号的红白条纹炸鸡桶。她指尖捏着一块金黄酥脆的炸鸡，空气中悬浮着清晰可见的碎屑和细小的酥脆鳞片。桶内可见 7 块炸鸡：手中 1 块，中间簇拥 4 块，前缘底部 1 块模糊的大块，右侧边缘 1 块大块。炸鸡桶正面需展示简洁的黑色上校头像 Logo 和醒目的 KFC 字样。模特妆容精致迷人，红唇，肤色红润有光泽，深色长发盘成优雅凌乱的发髻，佩戴小巧的金质圆圈耳环，表情自信诱人，略微俯视镜头。服装：深红色无袖修身上衣或连衣裙，白色短款夹克配卷袖，白色高腰裹裙或围裙式裁片，搭配红色侧边，营造出奢华的红白品牌色调。背景：极简主义奶油色摄影棚墙面，带有强烈的几何红色建筑面板和对角线阴影，温暖的阳光，高端商业摄影布光，浅景深，炸鸡纹理清晰，呈现时尚杂志般的光泽感。在左上方添加标题文本：CRAVE THE CRUNCH，使用宽间距大写衬线字体，深红色。下方添加较小的副标题：Freshly crispy. Made to tempt.。排版保持优雅简洁，留出充足的负空间。风格应融合奢华时尚大片与快餐广告，照片级写实，细节丰富，食物纹理诱人，手部伸展动作具有动态感，除桶身品牌标识和海报文字外，不添加任何额外的 Logo 或水印。
